definitions.explanation: The state of all available items or tickets having been sold, with none remaining. Used for merchandise, tickets, and limited-edition products.

examples.japanese: ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{完売|かんばい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦{初日|しょにち}→初日：11741_shonichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{完売|かんばい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The limited-edition product sold out on the first day of release.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし}→発売開始：22166_hatsubaikaishi⟧⟦{数分|すうふん}→数分：21623_suufun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{完売|かんばい}になった。
examples.english: Since it was a popular concert, tickets sold out within minutes of going on sale.

notes:
Composed of {完|かん} (complete) + {売|ばい} (sell). Indicates that all stock or tickets have been sold with none remaining.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {完売|かんばい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sell out (active)
- {完売|かんばい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become sold out (change of state)
- {完売|かんばい}⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧: sold out (already completed)
- {完売|かんばい}{御礼|おんれい}: thank you, sold out (seen on signs)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{完売|かんばい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: tickets sell out
- ⟦{即日|そくじつ}→即日：09661_sokujitsu⟧{完売|かんばい}: sold out the same day
- ⟦{発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし}→発売開始：22166_hatsubaikaishi⟧⟦{直後|ちょくご}→直後：04525_chokugo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{完売|かんばい}: sold out immediately after going on sale

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れ→売り切れ：09556_urikire⟧: sold out (more colloquial, used in everyday speech and shop signs)
- ⟦{品切|しなぎ}れ→品切れ：09557_shinagire⟧: out of stock (focuses on availability rather than sales)

REGISTER:
{完売|かんばい} is more formal than ⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れ→売り切れ：09556_urikire⟧ and is commonly used in business, event, and media contexts.
